name: Ray-Image Frame Intersection
definition: Computes the intersection of a camera-space ray with lines parallel to the image frame axes (x=0, x=1, y=0, y=1) in normalized image coordinates.
summary: Ray-Image Frame Intersection computes where a camera-space ray crosses normalized 2D image boundaries using analytic solutions, differing from volume intersection by operating on 2D frames rather than 3D boxes.
